# <span id="aanchor230"></span> Import Rules Editor

Use the Import Rules Editor to create rules that reject the import of specific periodic records. If this option is configured, imported records with differential pressure, static pressure, or temperature values that are too high, too low, or missing will be rejected.

Conditional import rules work for all files types; however, they will not work with Transaction Queue data.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Import Rule Editor and create a new import rule:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**.

2.  Select **Import Rules Editor** within the **Application** group.

3.  Click the **New** button.

4.  Enter a name and/or description for the new rule.

5.  Specify the criteria for the import rules by making the appropriate selections from the drop-down lists and entering a value.

    For liquid data, Pressure and Temperature rules will apply to meter pressure and meter temperature. They will not apply to observed pressure and observed temperature.

6.  If additional criteria are needed, click the **New Row** button.

7.  Click the **Validate** button to check the rule syntax.

8.  Click the **Save** button.

Clicking the **Clear** button will remove all criteria, including name and description.

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Apply">

<div class="procedure">

To apply an import rule to a meter:

1.  Go to **Setup** \> **Meter** \> **Editor**.
2.  Select a meter and click the **Edit** button.
3.  Click the **Imports** tab.
4.  In the Conditional Import Rules section, provide a rule in the **Reject if True** field.
5.  Click the **Save** button.

You can also use the Bulk Changes screen to apply an import rule to multiple meters using a location or list.

</div>
